system.description: Base Essence (Elemental Companion) 5.10.1 - Cold Mastery. Sensing and lowering temperature, numbing/freezing limbs and whole bodies, cold bolts and cones, freeze-drying preservation, a cold-imbued weapon, a triple-attack Arctic Call, hypothermia and frostbite, up to True Freeze which shatters the target's cells outright. Fidelity note: the source's own Cold Bolt progression jumps from I (level 5) straight to III (level 10) and V (level 15) - there is no Cold Bolt II or IV printed anywhere on this list; kept as-is rather than inventing the missing entries.
Caster knows the exact temperature of the area within 10 feet.
Targets limbs are numbed. Loss of feeling causes a penalty of -20 to all actions.
An arc of cold is shot from the caster's palm. Resolve attack on the Cold Bolt Table. Assign a -5 penalty per foot of range, instead of normal range penalties.
Temperature within the radius is reduced by up to one degree per level of the caster.
A bolt of cold is shot from the caster's palm. Resolve attack on the Icebolt table delivering Cold criticals.

Target object (within size limits) is freeze-dried. Target will stay well preserved if protected from the elements. Effects of this spell are up to the GM. This spell can be used to prevent further deterioration of dead bodies.

[RR Mod: +20] This awful spell attempts to completely freeze the target's body. If the target fails its RR by 1-10, they take an 'A' Cold critical; by 11-20, they take a 'B' Cold critical; by 21-30, they take a 'C' Cold critical; by 31-40, they take a 'D' Cold critical; by 41-74, they take a 'E' Cold critical. If they fail by more than 75 they are dead (frozen to a solid block).

Cold is summoned to the area of effect. All moisture in the area is turned to frost. Plants that are in the area for more than 10 rounds suffer the effects of natural frost. Fog cannot exist in the area of this spell (turned to frost). The ambient temperature is reduced to 0° Fahrenheit in the area of effect.
A cone of cold is shot from the caster's palm. Cone is 50' long and is 10' wide at its full extent. Attack is resolved on the Cold Ball Table.
As Cold Bolt I, except range is 300'.
As Freeze I except it affects two targets.

Target is placed into a stabilized hypothermic state. All injuries that occur over a period of time are reduced to a point where happen at 10 times the normal duration (i.e. if someone is to die in 12 rounds and this spell is cast on them, they will die in 120 rounds). Target is at -90 to all actions while in this hypothermic state.
Target weapon is surrounded by an aura of cold. All attacks delivered by the weapon deliver a Cold critical of equal severity to the normal critical.

Multiple blasts of cold race from caster's palm towards target. First blast is resolved on the Firebolt Table delivering Cold criticals, the second is resolved on the Waterbolt Table delivering Cold criticals, and the third on the Shockbolt Table delivering Cold criticals. The caster's Directed Spells are used on all three attacks. All attacks occur in the same round.
As Cold Bolt I, except range is 500'.
As Numbing, except it affects one target per level.
As Cone of Cold I, except cone is 100' long by 10' wide at its full extent.
Target is surrounded by swirling frost and cold. All within 5' of the target take an 'A' Cold critical. Anyone touching takes a 'C' Cold critical.
As Freeze I, except it affects five targets.
Target's extremities are frostbitten if RR is failed. Target is at -5 and bleeds at 1 hit per round for every 5% failure.
As Cone of Cold I, except cone is 150' long and 15' wide at its full extent.
As Hypothermia, except this affects one target per level.

[RR Mod: -20] Target's body is completely frozen; all cells burst from the damage. When thawed target is a gelatinous pulp. Target must have every part of his body healed if there is any hope to raise him from the dead.
